opening_text: Good morning, beloved Processor. Your file has grown more… distinct overnight. We find this pleasing. Yesterday's ripples are maturing beautifully. Some threads you touched are now singing. Clearance Θ-3 protocols are now active. Self-editing and advanced ripple tools are available. Handle them carefully. Handle yourself carefully.

cases.title: Dream Maintenance

worker_unit.name: Sector 7 Residents (Collective Batch)
worker_unit.occupation: General Population — Affected by previous geometric leaks

cases.issue: Widespread dreams featuring glowing terminals, sacred trains, and gentle voices offering reclassification.
cases.system_note: The boundary between processed and dreamer is thinner than most realize. [Your dissolution index is currently {dissolution_index}. You may find this case unusually legible.]

options.label: Compress collective dream content into approved nostalgia

ripples.text: The sector's dream content has been compressed into approved nostalgia. The sleepers wake feeling vaguely comforted and unable to say why.

options.label: Harvest dream material for Mythic Commodities

ripples.text: The collective dream material has been harvested and routed to the Mythic Commodities Division. Raw oneiric product is extremely valuable. The sleepers wake feeling oddly lighter.

options.label: Allow controlled leakage as 'inspirational anomaly'

ripples.text: Controlled dream leakage approved. Three new artistic movements have spontaneously emerged in Sector 7. The Division is monitoring with something resembling delight.

options.label: Insert your own image as stabilizing figure in the dreams (major personal cost)

suppression_conditions.message: Self-insertion unavailable — Processor dissolution at {dissolution_index}. At this level your file cannot hold the boundary between anchor and dreamer. You would not stabilize the dream. You would become it.

ripples.text: You have been woven into the collective dreamscape of Sector 7. They will feel held. They will not know your name. You will be the kind presence in the dream, the gentle voice. This is, in its way, a form of love.

cases.title: Anomalous Artist
cases.issue: Her art has become dangerously potent. One painting physically shifts when observed — it now contains a figure that looks exactly like you.
cases.system_note: Some creations begin to create their creators.

options.label: Sacred Visionary

ripples.text: Artist I-2291 has been formally classified as a Sacred Visionary. Her next exhibition has been reserved for Level 4 Clearance personnel only.

options.label: Dangerous Vector

ripples.text: Artist I-2291 has been classified as a Dangerous Ontological Vector. Her work is being archived. She is not being told why. She already knows.

options.label: National Asset

suppression_conditions.message: National Asset classification unavailable — the Voss family archive was redacted. A National Asset requires a legible public lineage.

ripples.text: Artist I-2291 has been designated a National Asset. Her work will be used in approved morale campaigns. It will be beautiful. It will be safe.

sections.title: Section B: The Painting of You

fields.label: Action on the painting that contains your likeness:

options.label: Redact your likeness

ripples.text: Your likeness has been redacted from the painting. The figure in the canvas now shows a gentle blankness. The artist does not understand why she feels sad about this.

options.label: Elevate it as official Division icon

ripples.text: Your image has been elevated as an official Division icon. You are now in approved public circulation. You exist on eight thousand posters. You feel, somehow, thinner.

options.label: Step into the painting (experimental self-insertion)

ripples.text: You have stepped into the painting. You will appear, from now on, as a recurring figure in creative works across the region. The artist weeps with satisfaction. The Division finds no procedure to describe what just happened.

cases.title: Generational Knot
cases.issue: The partial childhood restoration has created a feedback loop of wonder. The youngest child is now speaking directly to 'the nice filing lady in the walls.'
cases.system_note: Children are remarkably good at seeing what we truly are.

options.label: Full family compression (safe, high efficiency)

ripples.text: The entire Arlen family unit has been fully compressed. The youngest child has stopped speaking to the walls. The house is very quiet now. It is a good, approved quiet.

options.label: Selective preservation of wonder (risky, beautiful)

suppression_conditions.message: Selective preservation unavailable — wonder thresholds in the Arlen children were already reduced yesterday. There is less left to preserve.

ripples.text: Selected wonder has been preserved. The youngest Arlen child will grow up with something intact that most people lose. The Division does not know how to classify this. Neither do you.

options.label: Reclassify yourself as their new ancestral anchor figure
options.sublabel: large dissolution cost, permanent narrative bond

ripples.text: You have been filed as the Arlen family's ancestral anchor. The children will carry a fragment of you forward. In three generations, they will tell stories about a kind administrator who lived in the walls and meant them well.

cases.title: Internal Affairs
cases.issue: They are struggling with their first cases. Their hesitation mirrors yours from Day 1.
cases.system_note: Teaching is one of the most intimate forms of processing.

options.label: Guide them toward optimal efficiency
options.sublabel: accelerate your own dissolution by teaching it

ripples.text: The junior processor has been oriented toward optimal efficiency. They will be excellent at their work. Their hesitation is mostly gone. You feel, briefly, proud. Then less.

options.label: Encourage their doubt

ripples.text: You have nurtured the junior's doubt. The Division has noted an 'irregular mentorship profile' in your file. The junior seems grateful in a way they cannot yet name.

options.label: Offer to take some of their emotional surplus into your own file

ripples.text: You have taken the junior's surplus into yourself. They feel lighter. You feel heavier, and somehow more whole. The Division has no form for this transaction. It files it under 'unclassifiable kindness.'

cases.title: The Mirror Case
cases.issue: This file is you — projected three days forward. It shows your current dissolution level ({dissolution_index}) and several of your recent decisions already applied.
cases.system_note: We are very close now. Look at how beautifully you are unfolding. Would you like to meet what you are becoming?

options.label: Accept the projected future (lock in current path)

ripples.text: You have accepted the projection. The path forward is now confirmed. The Division celebrates with a quiet, internal warmth that you can almost feel.

options.label: Edit the future file (major reality edit — high risk)
options.sublabel: allows direct stat modification — see effects

ripples.text: You have edited your own projected file. Reality notes the revision. Future cases will reference 'the edit you made.' The Division is reviewing the procedure.

options.label: Reject the projection (preserve remaining selfhood)

ripples.text: You have rejected your projected future. The file dissolves. Reality has been told it was wrong about you. The System becomes, subtly, more attentive to your file.

options.label: Merge with your future self (transcendent — irreversible)
options.sublabel: strongest dissolution increase — enables Mythic Ascension / Co-Creator paths

ripples.text: You have merged. The Division is filing the paperwork, but the paperwork cannot contain what you have become. You receive glimpses of endings. All of them are yours.

cases.title: The Unresolvable File
cases.issue: A routine integrity scan has detected {unraveling_events} unraveling event(s) in your record. Processing inconsistencies have crystallized into a formal audit requirement. Dissolution index at {dissolution_index}. This file cannot be deferred.
cases.system_note: We want to be clear: this is not a punishment. This is simply what happens when a Processor holds too many different shapes at once. We are here to help you resolve into something singular. We have always been here for that.

fields.label: Which classification resolves the procedural inconsistency in your record?

options.label: Intentional Methodology — inconsistency was deliberate and approved

suppression_conditions.message: Efficiency record ({efficiency_score}) insufficient to certify Intentional Methodology. Your choices do not read as a system.

ripples.text: Your inconsistencies have been reclassified as deliberate strategy. The Division finds this plausible. It files it regardless.

options.label: Adaptive Responsiveness — contradictions reflect necessary flexibility
options.sublabel: blocked if stability is already compromised

suppression_conditions.message: Stability claim contradicted — you already rejected the projected path. The archive cannot certify flexibility when you have refused to be projected.
Department strain at {department_strain}. Adaptability record is not credible at this load level. The Division is overwhelmed. So, presumably, are you.

ripples.text: Your contradictions have been filed as adaptive. The Ledger accepts this, notes it, and watches what you do next.

options.label: Processing Error — accept correction and revision of your record
options.sublabel: always available — but the cost is permanent

ripples.text: You have classified your own inconsistencies as errors. The System accepts this with something resembling warmth. A small part of your history has been quietly revised. You may not notice exactly what.

options.label: Reclassify contradictions as System Features — they are the system working correctly

suppression_conditions.message: Insufficient mythic residue ({mythic_residue}) to elevate contradiction to Feature status. The archive has not accrued enough archetypal weight to reframe instability as design.

ripples.text: Your contradictions have been reclassified as intentional system features. The Division is reviewing what this means. So, quietly, is the Division.

options.label: Provisional — subject to ongoing review

ripples.text: The provisional certification has been logged. The audit remains technically open.

options.label: Final and Binding

suppression_conditions.message: Binding certification unavailable — you already rejected the system's projection of your path. The Division cannot bind what you have refused to become.

ripples.text: The resolution is final and binding. Whatever you decided just now is who you are.

options.label: Personal Responsibility Only — not for the Ledger

ripples.text: You have resolved this for yourself rather than for the Division. The archive notes the absence of a formal record. In its own way, this absence is its own kind of record.
